title: Serino 2015 peri-trunk PPS Experiment 1
citation: Serino, A., Noel, J. P., Galli, G., Canzoneri, E., Marmaroli, P., Lissek, H., & Blanke, O. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Peri-trunk looming/receding task originally implemented with a two-speaker analog setup. Timing, distance, and trial-count fields are literature-derived; the toolkit recreates the reported near-far trajectory with the binaural spatial renderer rather than treating the speakers as a separate audio source. A 100-ms derived terminal margin contains the existing software cue; it is not a reported trial interval or evidence of full-protocol timing equivalence.

reference_parameters.analog_apparatus_recreation: Original near/far speakers are modeled as the reported 100 cm to 5 cm moving-sound trajectory in the binaural renderer.
reference_parameters.software_trial_padding_basis: Derived containment for the existing software timeline: pre=0 ms; post=max(0,max(SOA)+cue duration-source duration)=4318+100-4318=100 ms. Serino et al. 2015 main article pp.11-13 and Supplementary Methods: 100-ms cue and 500-700-ms ITI; exact numerical SOAs/sound duration/onset origin remain unresolved. The existing sampled-distance/speed timeline is a proxy under an assumed 100-cm origin. A 100-ms terminal margin only contains its final cue; it is not the reported ITI or source-reported silence.

provenance.source: Scientific Reports results report D1-D6 as 5, 24, 43, 62, 81, and 100 cm.
Methods report 240 trials: multisensory D1-D6 plus baselines and catch trials by two directions and 16 repetitions.

provenance.field: software cue containment and source limitation
